title: Read-only command checker refuses ordinary Git identity inspection: `git merge-base` is not allowed and unquoted `REV^{tree}` peel syntax trips the brace refusal
outcome: Read-only command checker refuses ordinary Git identity inspection: `git merge-base` is not allowed and unquoted `REV^{tree}` peel syntax trips the brace refusal
acceptance: The read-only checker accepts an unquoted Git peel suffix of the form REV^{TYPE} (for example HEAD^{tree}, HEAD^{commit}, v1^{}) where the braces contain no comma and no `..`, and still refuses brace expansion such as {a,b} and {1..3}; a test shows both.

The read-only checker accepts `git merge-base` in its read-only forms (plain, --is-ancestor, --fork-point, --all, --octopus, --independent) and refuses any token that is not one of those options or a revision; a test shows an accepted form and a refused unknown option.
Every existing read-only refusal (output and exec sinks, -C, --help, globs, substitutions) is unchanged; the existing read-only refusal tests pass.
